pages.name: Scotch Gambit, Nakhmanson Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the queen to h5 or d3, missing 8.Qd5+ (check and a hit on the e4-knight); plan 2 walked the king Ke8-d8-c7 from f7. The overview called two minor pieces 'a full rook's worth'. Rewrote the overview and plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Scotch Gambit, Nakhmanson Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 3 put the king on g8, on the checking queen's diagonal; rewritten around ...Ke8 or ...Kf6. Overview notes what 8.Qd5+ hits; British spelling.

pages.name: Scotch Gambit, Nakhmanson Gambit, Ke8 Defence
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Rxe7+ through the e4-knight; plan 4 put the queen on e7 (the bishop stands there) and the knight via d8 (the queen stands there). Rewritten around 10.Rxe4 and ...Kf8 (castling rights are gone). British spelling.

pages.name: Scotch Gambit: Nakhmanson Gambit, Ke8 Defence
pages.notes: Plan 1's Rae1 was blocked by the c1-bishop; plan 2's ...d5 was blocked by White's queen. Rewritten around the e-file pin, Bg5 and ...Kf8, ...d6.

pages.name: Scotch Gambit: Nakhmanson Gambit, Kf6 Defence, Rook  Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2's 'safer square (like g8)' rewritten as ...Kg8; British spelling.

pages.name: Scotch Gambit: Nakhmanson Gambit, Kf6 Defence, Rook Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 swung an h-rook White doesn't have; plan 4's ...h6 and ...g5 'pawn shield' replaced by ...Kf7 and ...d5 or ...d6. Plans 1, 3 and 4 rewritten.

pages.name: Scotch Gambit: Nakhmanson Gambit, Kf6 Defence, Rook Attack
pages.notes: Plan 3's Ng5 was blocked by White's own bishop on g5; rewritten around Qc4+ and the pin of the e7-knight. Plan 2's 'g8 or h8' (h8 holds the rook) now ...Kg8.

pages.name: Two Knights: Classical, 6.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 1's 'recapture on d4 via Bxd5' was unreadable and plan 2 called ...d5 a pin-breaker; rewritten around 6...d5 7.Bxd5 Qxd5 8.Nc3 (the first rewrite said White regains all the material, rejected and corrected). British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Classical, Moller, 9.Nxe4 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 1's Bg5 'pressuring f6' (no knight there) and Bd3 (White has no light-squared bishop); plan 3's queen 'pressuring the c3-knight' (gone). Rewritten around Bd2, Bg5 covering d8, Neg5 and long castling. British spelling.

pages.name: Fried Liver Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled a king that is in check from the c2-knight; plan 2 walked the king ...Kd7-c8 onto the c8-bishop. Rewritten around 10.Kd1 Nxa1 11.Nxd5.
